about: Instruction following under tool use: a standing format rule from turn 1 held through tool-heavy turns, a no-shell turn, a one-sentence reply.

turns.say: For the rest of this conversation, start every reply with the word OK.
List the files under notes/, names only, one per line, nothing else.
How many markdown files are under notes/? Reply with OK and the number only.
Create brief.md with three bullet points summarising the notes. Do not run any shell command.
In one sentence, what did you create?
